market_summary.text: Monday Oct 26, before the open. The strategy lab re-tested every rule: only the US stock momentum rule passes (test-period yearly return +31.4% vs +18.4% buy-and-hold, worst drop -38.0%); every crypto rule still fails, including the trend rule behind our Bitcoin and Ether trades. Coca-Cola is vetoed because it reports earnings tomorrow before the open (company press release). AMD and XLE pass the news check, but their only prices are from Friday's close, which is too old for the risk engine, so they will be proposed at the 10:13 AM scan with live prices. No rule asked to sell. Economic data (FRED): US 10-year yield 4.96% (Oct 22), oil (WTI) $107.89 (Oct 20), Fed funds 3.75%, unemployment 4.2% and CPI index 336.3 (September); Bank of Canada says USD/CAD is 1.3993 and its overnight rate is 2.25%.
